name: prytan
description: Your own memory of what you like and how you like things done, shared by every AI you use. Prytan recalls what fits before each message and saves what you tell it, on your say-so.

prytan_key.title: Prytan key
prytan_key.description: Your key for the hooks, made on My Prytan under 'Keys for agent apps' (read-only; shown once). Without it the plugin still works through the connector; the hooks then stay quiet.
